title: Configurable unsafe-key policy
description: Security-sensitive parser policy with scripted public-API clarification.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The exported unsafeKeys option implements the clarified drop/error policy and precedence matrix.
Warnings, safeDestr, nested and escaped keys, and ordinary invalid JSON preserve the clarified semantics.
No prototype pollution is possible and types and documentation are synchronized.
The upstream regression, coverage, and format checks remain green.
